title: AFI Signal Reassessment v1 (DLC-CHECKPOINT — the sealed half-life checkpoint artifact)
description: (afi.signal-reassessment.v1) The sealed artifact a validator — human or automated, same contract (DLC-GOV D-DLC-4(4)) — emits at/post a scored signal's stamped half-life: the comparison of the sealed assertion against the captured realization for that one signal. It NEVER mutates the scored record (immutability attaches at SCORED, CFG-GOV); it links by signalId and lives beside, never inside, the canonical evidence plane.
$comment: BOUNDARY (DLC-GOV D-DLC-4(3)): the member set is EXHAUSTIVE — the checkpoint time, the horizons read, the realized figures consumed, the reassessment reading, and the signalId linkage, plus the artifact form (schema, seal). Nothing more without a further filing. Realized figures are copied VERBATIM from the signal_outcomes rows read; nothing here recomputes market data, and no member is a new score.
x-afiPartOf: AFI Decay Lifecycle v0.1 (DLC-GOV), slot DLC-CHECKPOINT
x-afiDoctrineRefs: afi-governance/decisions/decay-lifecycle-v0.1.md D-DLC-4 (checkpoint semantics; sealed-artifact form; exhaustive members; named sealing question answered here)
afi-governance/decisions/decay-horizon-alignment-v0.1.md D-DH-2 (the {H/4, H/2, H} stamped-horizon capture this artifact consumes, unchanged)
afi-governance/decisions/analyst-configuration-freedom-v0.1.md (immutability attaches at SCORED — a reassessment never mutates the scored record)
afi-governance/decisions/persistence-v0.1.md D-MONGO-3 (the artifact lives beside, never inside, the canonical evidence plane)

x-afiConstraints.sealingDiscipline: THE D-DLC-4(3) SEALING ANSWER: the artifact is sealed by canonical-json-hashing.v1 (afi.hash.v1) exactly as tests/canonical-hashing-kat.test.ts executes it — seal.value is the sha256 of the canonical serialization of this document with the single TOP-LEVEL member 'seal' excluded; the domain tag afi.checkpoint.signal-reassessment is carried, never hashed. Proven by governed vectors: every valid vector's seal.value reproduces under the reference implementation.
x-afiConstraints.checkpointEligibility: A reassessment exists only at/post the stamped half-life: checkpointTime.elapsedMinutes >= checkpointTime.halfLifeMinutes (DLC-GOV D-DLC-4(1); eligibility is a derived time predicate, not a lifecycle state). Draft-07 cannot compare members; the semantic layer enforces it.
x-afiConstraints.horizonAlignment: horizonsRead, realizedFigures, and reassessmentReading.perHorizon carry exactly the same horizon-label set, row-for-row: the reading reads what was read, nothing else. Semantic layer.
x-afiConstraints.readingDeterminism: reassessmentReading is a DETERMINISTIC classification (rule signedReturnPct-sign-v1) of the copied figures, never a judgment call and never a new score: per horizon, signedReturnPct null → indeterminate, > 0 → favorable, < 0 → adverse, exactly 0 → flat; overall over the non-indeterminate horizons — all favorable → confirmed, all adverse → contradicted, otherwise mixed; no non-indeterminate horizon → indeterminate. Semantic layer recomputes both levels.
x-afiConstraints.verbatimRealization: Every realizedFigures member is copied verbatim from the signal_outcomes row it names (afi.operational.signal-outcome.v0.1); this artifact never re-fetches or recomputes market data (DLC-GOV D-DLC-4(2)).
x-afiConstraints.immutability: Append-only, one reassessment per signalId at the store surface; a reassessment is never edited and the scored record is never touched (D-DLC-4(3)).

schema.description: Schema-id version of the sealed reassessment artifact.

signalId.description: The D-DLC-4(3) linkage: the scored signal this reassessment checkpoints. The sealed record itself is never referenced by copy, only by this id.

checkpointTime.description: The checkpoint moment, self-proving: elapsedMinutes >= halfLifeMinutes is the eligibility predicate (semantic layer).

scoredAt.description: The sealed scoring timestamp the clock runs from (D-DLC-3(1)).

halfLifeMinutes.description: The determination's stamped half-life (TDR-GOV stamp), copied verbatim.

horizonsRead.description: The captured horizons this checkpoint read (DH-GOV rows), label-for-label.

horizon.description: The outcome row's horizon label (DH-GOV label grammar).

horizonBasis.description: The row's recorded basis, copied verbatim.

fractionOfHalfLife.description: Present exactly when the row is decay-derived (0.25 / 0.5 / 1).

realizedFigures.description: The realization, copied VERBATIM from the signal_outcomes rows read — never recomputed here.

evaluatedAt.description: When the capture run wrote the row.

signedReturnPct.description: Direction-signed return % (null for a neutral assertion) — the reading's sole classification input.

mfePct.description: Max favorable excursion %, copied if the row carries it.

maePct.description: Max adverse excursion %, copied if the row carries it.

reassessmentReading.description: The deterministic assertion-vs-realization reading (x-afiConstraints.readingDeterminism). Not a score; a classification.

direction.description: The sealed assertion's direction, copied verbatim.

rule.description: The governed classification rule this reading was produced by.

seal.description: CanonicalHash v1 sealing this artifact (x-afiConstraints.sealingDiscipline): sha256 over the canonical serialization with the top-level 'seal' member excluded; domain tag afi.checkpoint.signal-reassessment carried, never hashed.
